verdict.rationale: Brex claims AI-powered automation (invoice entry, approval, GL coding) and offers Webhooks/Budgets/Accounting APIs that could underpin background automations, but community feedback directly disputes the reliability and production-readiness of Brex's AI features (hallucination risk, non-deterministic outputs, factual errors in official demos) and even claims Brex lagged behind competitors like Ramp on AI adoption.
